attacks.name: Strongarm Impact
attacks.effect: You may do 30 more damage. If you do, discard the top 3 cards of each player's deck.

attacks.name: Ultra Pump
attacks.effect: You may discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Energy Recycle
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for 3 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Swampert ex is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hyper Pump
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each basic Energy attached to Swampert ex but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 80 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Crushing Wave
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. After doing damage, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent discards an Energy card, if any, attached to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mud Flood
attacks.effect: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. This attack does 40 more damage for each Water Energy you find there. Shuffle the revealed cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Hydro Tackle
attacks.effect: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.effect: Discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water or Fighting Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Water Call
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Natural Remedy
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Swampert, remove 1 damage counter from Swampert.

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

abilities.name: Echo Draw
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Sonic
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

abilities.name: Water Cyclone
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water Energy attached to 1 of your Active Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, you may switch your opponent's Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.effect: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Swampert.

abilities.name: Root Protector
abilities.effect: Any damage done to Swampert by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mud Splash
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Power Draw
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Muddy Maker
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may attach a {W} Energy card or a {F} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: α Growth
abilities.effect: When you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon (except with an attack, Ability, or Trainer card), you may attach 2 Energy cards.

abilities.name: Diving Search
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.
